limits: Regular synthetic images only. Existing journal-* cases contain manually injected transactions; native-journal-* cases use debugfs journal_write with explicit corruption/layout controls. No mounted-kernel crash, physical device, fast commit or external journal claim.
provenance: Images generated from synthetic regular files by e2fsprogs 1.47.3; no mounted/personal device. Header hints deliberately include damaged synthetic content and are not decoded-image controls.
journal_provenance: native-journal-* transactions were written by debugfs 1.47.3 journal_write, with per-case commands/hash provenance. Original journal-* fixtures are manual transaction layouts. Corruption/ring-layout mutations are explicit synthetic controls, not native crash specimens.
